Based on the provided financials, the company exhibits a very strong credit profile characterized by solid profitability (15% operating margin), a highly conservative capital structure with low leverage (Debt-to-Equity of at most 0.61x, with total liabilities representing only 38% of total assets), and excellent liquidity (current ratio of 2.48). While these metrics point to an investment-grade profile, the absolute size of the business (revenue of $3.1B and assets under $5B) limits its ability to achieve the highest rating categories (AAA/AA range) which are typically reserved for much larger, systemically diversified multinational corporations. Therefore, a solid upper-medium investment grade rating is appropriate to reflect its strong financial cushion balanced against its moderate scale.

DECISION: A-
